title: Chicken tail: remove or harvest?
summary: In some markets, the chicken tail is simply a part that needs to be removed to allow for precise anatomical leg cutting. But in other markets, tail meat is an edible, valuable food ingredient that deserves to be carefully harvested. The JBT Marel TailCutter HP in the ACM cut-up line can do it all.
body_markdown:
#### Virtually no adjustments


Removal of the tail allows for anatomic leg processing downstream. The TailCutter HP in the ACM cut-up line works simply and cleanly. Once the module has been set up during installation, virtually no further adjustments are needed, even with wide flock variations or different breeds. Horizontal positioning and two guides ensure a good cut regardless of carcass size. There is no need for skilled labor.
